title: Canada demographic sampling inputs
description: Aggregate Canadian demographic marginals formatted for transparent weighted sampling.

methodology.sampling_assumption: Dimensions are sampled independently because this file contains no cross-tabulations or respondent-level microdata.
methodology.caution: This is a coarse synthetic-sampling input, not Statistics Canada PUMF microdata. Derived residual categories and approximations are identified below.

race_ethnicity.source_note: Reported population shares; listed values sum to 100%.

religious_affiliation.source_note: Reported shares sum to 99.3%; weighted sampling normalizes them automatically.

education_attainment.source_note: Approximation derived from 89% high-school-or-higher and more than 56% with a college or university credential.

mother_tongue.source_note: English and French shares were reported directly; Other is the residual to 100% and is therefore approximate.

urbanicity.source_note: Urban share is reported as more than 80%; this sampler uses 80/20 as an approximation.

household_composition.source_note: Four categories were reported directly; Other is the 8.1% residual required to reach 100%.

immigration_status.source_note: Immigrant share reported as 23%; Non-immigrant is the residual.
